row:
A comprehensive, two-year public community college, RCC offers two-year degrees, over 80 career and technical training programs; a variety of workforce and short-term training, academic skills and community education classes, in addition to services to the business community. 

Established in 1970, RCC is accredited by the Northwest Commission on Colleges and Universities and serves residents in Jackson and Josephine counties through the Redwood Campus near Grants Pass, the Riverside Campus in downtown Medford, and the Table Rock Campus in White City.
